text: Thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-eight vibrations make one second on your watch.
Inside is a tiny sliver of quartz.
Put voltage on it, and it vibrates
thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-eight times a second.
That number is two to the fifteenth.
A chip halves the signal fifteen times in a row:
sixteen thousand, three hundred eighty-four, eight thousand, one hundred ninety-two, all the way down to one.
It's this fast because a slower crystal
